description: This file defines core data structures and evaluation logic for executing approval workflows in a security or command execution context within an application. It includes a data structure for representing evaluation results (`ExecApprovalEvaluation`) and an evaluator class (`ExecApprovalEvaluator`) with static methods to assess command execution permissions based on various security policies and trust criteria.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: A data structure representing the result of evaluating whether a command execution is approved, including various security checks, patterns, and match information.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to evaluate command execution approval based on security policies, trust settings, and allowlists.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a given command is approved based on security policies, agent info, and environment context, returning an `ExecApprovalEvaluation` object.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a command's resolution is automatically allowed based on trusted bin paths and executable names.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: A test helper verifying the functionality of `isSkillAutoAllowed`.
